criteria.criterion: The commit is the stamped one; else the build's VCS revision when Go recorded one, with -dirty appended when the tree was modified; else unknown.

When the build carries a module version (anything but (devel) or empty), vloop version --json has "module" right after "commit", absent when there is none; and when the commit is unknown the text line is `vloop <version> (module <module version>, plugin <plugin>, <go> <os>/<arch>)`. Otherwise the text line is as today.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/version.go has the Module field after Commit with omitempty and the module text line, but no committed test exercises vloop version with a module: TestVersionJSON/TestVersionText are untouched and nothing asserts the key, its position or the new text line

criteria.criterion: doctor's self-hosting check passes a binary whose module version is a release (vX.Y.Z, with no pre-release or pseudo-version suffix), as it passes a stamped one; an unknown commit with no release module version still warns.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/doctor.go new case; TestDoctorSelfHostingInstalledRelease asserts pass for v0.8.0 and warning for a pseudo-version

criteria.criterion: Reading the build info is behind a seam the committed tests inject (a module version, a revision, a modified flag) — no test publishes or installs anything. TestVersionJSON, TestVersionText (internal/cli/root_test.go), TestDoctorSelfHostingUnstamped (internal/cli/doctor_test.go) and the version line of TestWorkedExampleEnglishSession (cmd/vloop/e2e_test.go) change only as the new behaviour requires.
criteria.evidence: readBuildInfo seam in buildinfo.go injected by TestResolveBuild; e2e build adds -buildvcs=false only to keep the unknown commit

criteria.criterion: No refactor from B15's list is folded in.
criteria.evidence: diff touches only build info, version, doctor and their tests

findings.summary: the new version output (module JSON key after commit, module text line when commit is unknown) ships with no committed test

notes: Implementation reads correct; only the version command's new output needs a test (JSON with and without Module, text with Module and unknown commit, text with Module and a known commit unchanged).
